text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: I did it! Me! I'm the Derby champion!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Did you see that?! This is me! This is the
real Gold
City!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

Голд Сити is incredible! She's the real
deal... I
hope she gets to wear the
winner's sash soon!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Right? Think of how gorgeous she'd look
in the
red one! I can't wait for the Kikuka
Sho!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
I can't believe a model can run like that!
You're so
cool, City!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
What? I'm a Derby champion now. Yet
they're still
talking about sashes and
modeling...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: But she's an awesome runner, too!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text: So that's how it is?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Not that my running is great, but that it's
great
"too."
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
This isn't a win at all. I'm still just a doll
to them!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: So? What a waste of energy.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Because they're all like, "She's not just good looking," or, "She runs well, for a model."
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
No matter what they say, they always
have to
mention my appearance.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: It's no different than before.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: I just want everyone to look at me and see me.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
But hey, if this is what I get even when I
win the
Derby, then maybe... you know...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: This is all there is.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: What?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: You can still become the strongest of all racers.

text_block_list.text: The Kikuka Sho...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
They say the Kikuka Sho goes to the
runner with
the greatest strength. If she
shows up big there,
she may be able to
rewrite her reputation.
choice_data_list: I don't want things to stay like this either.

text_block_list.text: Uh...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: I want people to recognize your strength!

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I just... lost confidence, I guess.
But don't
worry, I'm not giving up
halfway.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I can't let you be more excited about my
own
career than I am.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list:
We'll use this summer to make you stronger
than ever!

text_block_list.text: ...I'll hold you to that.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Okay then, I'll make a promise too, to
match your
enthusiasm.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I'm going to get stronger and win the
Kikuka Sho.
I'll sear the real me into
everyone's minds!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
